verdict.rationale: The GST portal could plausibly offer API-driven, non-interactive access, so the headless/CI axis applies. However, the evidence only shows a GST Developer Portal landing page (Register/Login) with no description of APIs, authentication for unattended use, or CI/headless workflows. The GST Offline Tool for uploading invoices is a manual desktop step, not headless automation, so no documented capability delivers the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
